description: Updates an existing Stripe customer, identified by customer_id, with only the provided details; unspecified fields remain unchanged.

inputSchema.description:
Request model for updating an existing customer in Stripe.
Only include fields that need to be modified; unspecified fields will remain unchanged.

address.description: Defines the customer's primary billing address.

city.description: City, district, suburb, town, or village.
city.title: City

address.title: Address

balance.description: An integer representing the customer's account balance in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD). A positive value credits the customer's balance, and a negative value debits it. This balance will be applied to future invoices.
balance.title: Balance

coupon.description: The ID of a coupon to apply to the customer. This coupon will be applied to the customer's subsequent invoices and subscriptions.
coupon.title: Coupon

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the Stripe customer to update.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

default_payment_method.description: The ID of a PaymentMethod to set as the customer's default for subscriptions and invoices.
default_payment_method.title: Default Payment Method

default_source.description: The ID of a card or bank account object to set as the customer's default payment source for charges and subscriptions. Deprecated in favor of `default_payment_method` for newer integrations.
default_source.title: Default Source

description.description: An arbitrary string providing additional information about the customer, often used for internal notes. Maximum 5000 characters.
description.title: Description

email.description: The customer's email address. Updating this may trigger a verification email to the new address.
email.title: Email

invoice_settings.description: Defines default settings for invoices created for this customer.

custom_fields.description: A list of up to 3 custom fields to be displayed on the customer's invoices. Each field is a dictionary with 'name' and 'value' keys. Example: [{'name': 'Purchase Order', 'value': 'PO-12345'}]
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

default_payment_method.description: The ID of a PaymentMethod to be set as the default for this customer's invoices.
default_payment_method.title: Default Payment Method

footer.description: Default footer text to be displayed on invoices for this customer. Maximum 500 characters.
examples: Thank you for your continued partnership!
footer.title: Footer

invoice_settings.title: InvoiceSettings

metadata.description: Key-value pairs for storing additional, unstructured information. Keys up to 40 characters, values up to 500.
metadata.title: Metadata
